leadText: Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel (Japanese: Volcanion and the Mechanical Magearna) is the adaptation of the movie of the same name. It is adapted by Kemon Kawamoto.
plainText:
Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel (Japanese: Volcanion and the Mechanical Magearna) is the adaptation of the movie of the same name. It is adapted by Kemon Kawamoto.

==Chapters==
Humans Lie
Our Home
Mine for the Taking
Let's Go
Not Powerless
Pokémon Lie...?

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Differences between the movie and the manga==
In the manga, travels alone without .
Levi and Cherie don't appear in the manga, with their roles replaced by several unnamed assistants to Alva. Therefore, only , Mega , Mega , Mega , Mega , and Mega appear in the manga, under control of Alva, along with his Mega .
Alva's staff has three Mega Wave jewels instead of one.
Kimia and Raleigh don't appear in the manga. Without Kimia's vehicles, Ash has to travel on 's back, and later, with a jetpack.
doesn't appear at all, making it the first time they haven't appeared in the manga adaptation of a movie.
There are two Pokémon hunters, instead of one like in the movie. One of them also uses Kimia's flying gear from the movie.
actively fights to protect the Nebel Plateau, before surrendering itself to Alva.
The structure of the flying fortress's interior is completely different in the manga.
Ash doesn't use any Pokémon other than . This leads to a climax battle of two against seven.
As Squishy is not in the manga, Nebel Plateau is protected from the destructive beam by the combined effort of all Pokémon in the Nebel Plateau.
At the end of the manga, Alva was arrested by Officer Jenny instead of Kimia.
